title: Make daemon pairing input tolerant and terminal outcomes visible through moe up
description: Consumer of task-5d982842645f4b2996396c67867abeec. Normalize a bounded operator label at both the launcher/private-pipe boundary and direct daemon entry, disclose the real approval outcome without echoing the label, and prove the secret-free request prompt plus outcome lines survive the real launcher filter.
definitionOfDone: VERIFY-OR-BLOCK: at delivered HEAD, drive the real pairing request route and prove it emits the exact secret-free request prompt only after success (task-5d982842645f4b2996396c67867abeec); if absent, report blocked because a launcher-only prompt fixture would not certify production.

Both moe-up-main and daemon-main trim surrounding ASCII whitespace and lowercase a well-formed label before their existing admission checks; an uppercase spelling and a trailing-space spelling reach the real approval window and approve.

The daemon prints exactly one plain outcome per approved, unknown-label, and expired-label submission: `Paired. APPROVED@CONTROL_ROOM_PAIRING_APPROVAL`, `That code is not one Moe is waiting for. PAIRING_CONFIRMATION_UNKNOWN@CONTROL_ROOM_PAIRING_APPROVAL`, or `That code expired - reload the browser page for a new one. PAIRING_REQUEST_EXPIRED@CONTROL_ROOM_PAIRING_APPROVAL`.

The real launcher output filter passes the exact request prompt and all three outcome lines, while continuing to suppress confirmation-label/request-id/credential/token diagnostics; the label value itself never appears in daemon stdout, launcher stdout, argv, env, or a URL.

Divergence fixtures prove the launcher normalization by inspecting the private child write before daemon validation, prove direct-daemon normalization by bypassing the launcher, and distinguish expired from unknown by creating the exact request then advancing the production monotonic clock past TTL. Mutation drills removing each normalization/disclosure and weakening secrecy red the named arm.
Daemon focused typecheck/test gates run standalone with exit 0 and nonzero counts; path-attributed broad red adds no failure on the four owned paths.
taskRails: Own only apps/daemon/src/daemon-main.ts, daemon-main.test.ts, orchestrator/moe-up-main.ts, and orchestrator/moe-up-main.test.ts.
Preserve/adopt the current foreign broken-pipe cancellation hunks in moe-up-main.ts/.test.ts only after exact-path provenance and byte-hash reconciliation; never overwrite or revert them.

Do not print, interpolate, restamp, or persist the confirmation label. Exact refusal code/layer comes from started.approvePairing; APPROVED is the existing success state, not a new authority vocabulary.
reopenReason: Superseded before planning: an additive response-header protocol avoids breaking the exact-key browser client between slices.

DIRTY-PATH HAZARD ON YOUR OWN OWNED FILES, measure it before you touch them: `git status --porcelain -- apps/daemon/src/orchestrator/moe-up-main.ts apps/daemon/src/orchestrator/moe-up-main.test.ts` returns ` M` on BOTH. Your rail 2 already names these ("preserve/adopt the current foreign broken-pipe cancellation hunks … only after exact-path provenance and byte-hash reconciliation; never overwrite or revert them"). No non-DONE row declares either path in a step's file field — I checked every task JSON — so the hunks are unowned WIP with no live claimant to ask. Hash them and reconcile before editing; do not assume they are yours.

MEASURED SURFACES YOUR PLAN WILL NEED (snapshot; re-run):
- The launcher filter is `SENSITIVE_DAEMON_LINE` at moe-up-main.ts:37 — `/(?:pair(?:ing)?[-_ ]?(?:token|ticket)|#(?:pair|manager)=|(?:pairing[-_ ]?)?request[-_ ]?id|confirmation[-_ ]?label|(?:session[-_ ]?)?credential)/iu` — applied by `suppressDaemonLine` (:51-54). Note it matches the PHRASE "confirmation label", so DoD-3's three outcome lines and DoD-4's prompt must be worded to survive it; that is the whole point of DoD-4's "passes … while continuing to suppress".
- Both admission checks you must normalize are the same literal regex `/^[0-9a-f]{4}(?:-[0-9a-f]{4}){2}$/u`: launcher at moe-up-main.ts (inside the `consumePairingOperatorLines` callback, ~:285) and daemon at daemon-main.ts:170-173. Rail: change one without the other and it is a no-op in production.
- daemon-main.ts:172 calls `started.approvePairing(line)` and DISCARDS the result — that discard is DoD-3's defect. The codes you must disclose are real and exported: `PAIRING_CONFIRMATION_UNKNOWN` and `PAIRING_REQUEST_EXPIRED` at pairing-approval-contract.ts:14/:18, layer `CONTROL_ROOM_PAIRING_APPROVAL` at :1.
- `consumePairingOperatorLines` (http/pairing-operator-channel.ts:27) already bounds lines to 96 bytes and delivers printable ASCII terminated by LF, stripping a trailing CR — so trailing-WHITESPACE tolerance is yours to add, but CR handling is already done; do not duplicate it.
